UPDATE reasoning.embedding_queue
            SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1,
                last_error = $2,
                next_attempt_at = now() + $4::bigint * interval '1 second',
                failed_at = CASE
                    WHEN $3 OR attempt_count + 1 >= 5 THEN now()
                    ELSE NULL
                END
            WHERE id = ANY($1)
